Ketosis is a natural process that the body initiates to help us survive when food intake is low. During this state, we produce ketones, which are produced from the breakdown of fats in the liver.

The ultimate goal of a properly maintained ketogenic diet is to force your body into this metabolic state. We do this not through calorie starvation, but carbohydrate starvation.

Our bodies are incredibly adaptive to what you put into it – when you overload it with fat and take away carbs, it will start burning ketones as its primary energy source.

How can I top up my virtual purse with coins?
To recharge with coins: connect to the vending machine by bringing the phone close to the MatiPay payment module and wait a few seconds: the orange LED will light up.
Is the led orange? You are connected! Insert the coins into the coin mechanism and the credit will be updated in real time!
Select the product you want to buy!

How can I top up my virtual wallet with a credit card?
To recharge by credit card: click on the ""Recharge"" button on the Homepage and enter the data from your credit card.
At the end of the recharge procedure, connect to the distributor and select the product you want to buy!
